tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skra chog sdig sgrib kun 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs/

mtshan tsam dran pa yis kyang ngan 'gro yi/ /sdug bsngal rgyu bcas drung nas rab 'byin pa/ /mngon dga'i zhing gi dpal gyur bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir tshe ldan gyi skra 'am/ tshe 'das kyi don du rus chog byed par 'dod na/ bum rdzas dang ldan pa'i bum pa mgul 'ching can dang mchod pa sta gon byas la/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal bar gyur/ bum pa/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las byung ba'i bum pa lto ba che ba mgrin pa ring ba mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshogs kyi bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyi 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba nas shrī ye āḥhūṃ/

zhes dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dbu rgyan par gyur/ mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon nas nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ak+ṣo bh+yaḥs pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ chos dbyings rang bzhin an+t+ra nī la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sa gnon mnyam gzhag can/ /lha yi gos dang rin chen rgyan mang mdzes/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i zla gdan gyi steng du hūṃ gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug nas sngags phreng la thim par gyur par bsams la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sarba sa twa nañtsa swā hā/ ci nus bzla'o/ yig brgya brjod de mchod bstod byas nas/ badz+ra muḥbum lha ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ bar bsam/ de nas skra'am rus pa gang yin kyang*/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ skra'am/ rus pa rnams kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ yig gi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa bum pa'i chu dang 'dres te/ skra'am/ rus pa rnams la thim pas che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs par gyur par bsams la/ kaṃ ka ni dang*/ rnam snang gi gzungs ring thung gnyis dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pra mar+dha na ye swā hā/

zhes pa rnams ci nus bzlas la/ bum pa'i chu 'khrus bya/ bar bar du sngags kyi mthar/ che ge mo'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig/ces brjod/ rgyas par bya na/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ sogs dang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ sogs dang*/ sa ni dug gi ma yin te/ zhes sogs re re'i mthar sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa brjod cing khrus bya'o/ /'di ni cung zad rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/ bsdus pa ni gzhan du bshad zin to/ /skra dang rus pa tsam du ma zad tshe ldan nam tshe 'das kyi so dang sen mo sogs la'ang de bzhin bya bar gsungs so/ /bkrus pa'i chu gtsang sar 'dor ram/ rus pa la sogs zhib par brdung ba'am/ skra lta bu bsreg pa'i thal ba dang sbyar nas swats+tsha 'debs pa'i sar bsres la/ sāts+tsha 'debs chog ltar bya'o/ /yang na rus pa sogs chu bo chen po dang*/ ri'i rtse nas rlung la bskur bar gsung*/ de ltar rus chog tshul bzhin du byas pa'am/ gzungs sngags ming spel dang bcas pa bris te mchod rten chen po dang*/ sats+tsha'i nang du bcug pa mang du byas na gang zag de ngan 'gro las grol bar 'gyur zhes mi 'khrugs pa'i rgyud las bshad do/ /na mo bai ro tsa na ye/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas skra 'am rus chog byed par 'dod na/ bum pa sogs sta gon byas te/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gi rnam snang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal bar gyur bar bsams/ bum pa sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i bum pa mtshan nyid/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du pad zla'i gdan la oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam snang dkar po zhal bzhi dkar ba/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas 'khor lo bsnams pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ bar bsams la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ bai ro tsa na ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /ting nge 'dzin ldan phyag rgya can/ /rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /ces pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i oṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi ngan song gi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa zhi bar byas/ 'od zer slar 'dus nas de nyid la thim par bsams la/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gzungs thung dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga te ba ri sho dha na rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya a r+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ shodha ne shodha ne sarba pā paṃ bi shodha bi shud dhe bi shud dhe/ sarba karma yā ba ra ṇa bi shodha ne swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring ci nus bzla/ mjug tu yig brgya dang mchod bstod byas te/ badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas khrus kyi tshe skra dang rus pa sogs gang yin kyang sngar mi 'khrugs pa'i skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin bya la/ 'dod na gzungs dang sbrel te kaṃ ka ni bzlas na'ang phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe khyad par ni skra 'am rus pa'i steng du oṃ yig gi mthar zhes bsgyur bar bya'o/ /kun rig gi cho ga sbyong ba dang bcas pa byed bzhin yin na 'di ltar ma byas kyang 'grub la/

byas na'ang mi 'gal bar ma zad shin tu legs pa yin no/ /mthar skra dang rus pa sogs ji ltar bya ba'ang mi 'khrugs pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar ro/ /na mo uṣ+ṇī ṣā bi dza ye/ 'dir rnam par rgyal ma'i sgo nas skra'am rus chog byed par 'dod na/ bum pa sogs sta gon byas la/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rnam par rgyal mar gsal bar gyur/ bum pa sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du pad zla'i gdan la bh+ruṃ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pas rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas zhal ser/ g.yon zhal sngon po yid tsam khro ba/ zhal re re la'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje/ gnyis pas 'od dpag med/ gsum pas mda'/ bzhi pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas te zhags pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pas mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung shis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu brgyan par gyur par bsams la/ mchod pa sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ār+ya uṣ+ṇīṣā bi dza ya sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog

/zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pas bstod/ rje btsun pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi las sgrib ma lus pa sbyangs rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur par bsams la/ gzungs ring ci nus bzla/ mjug tu yig brgya brjod de/ mchod bstod byas la/ badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de nas khrus kyi tshe skra'am/ rus pa'i steng du bh+ruṃ yig gi mthar zhes bsgyur ba ma gtogs/ sngar mi 'khrugs pa'i skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin te/ 'dod na gzungs kyi 'phror mi 'khrugs pa dang*/ rnam snang gi gzungs ring thung gnyis bzlas na'ang phun sum tshogs par 'gyur la/ mjug tu skra sogs ji ltar bya ba'ang sngar mi 'khrugs pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar ro/ /sngar bshad pa de las cung zad bsdus pa byed na/ rang nyid lha gang 'dod pa der bskyed de/ bum pa dri bzang gi chus phyed tsam bkang ba a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las byung ba'i bum pa'i nang du zla ba'i gdan la hūṃ yig gi mthar yi ge brgya pa la sogs pa'i sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od dang bdud rts-i'i rnam par bsdus nas sngags 'phreng la thim/ de nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur bar bsams te/ yig brgya/ kaṃ ka ni/ dur ga te/ rnam rgyal gyi gzungs ring*/ gtsug tor dri med/ pad+ma uṣ+ṇīṣā rnams ci 'grub bzla/ de nas skra'am rus pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ skra'am/ rus pa'i steng du zla gdan la hūṃ yig dkar po/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar chil chil babs pas/

che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs shing dag par gyur/ ces brjod cing*/ gzungs de rnams bzla zhing mthar spel tshig sbyar la bkru bar bya'o/ /spyir sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs mang na'ang ngan song sbyong ba la bsngags pa'i gzungs sngags khyad par can la brten nas 'di ltar byed pa ni 'jug pa bde zhing*/ gang la dmigs pa de nyid ngan song las thar bar 'gyur ba sogs phan yon kyang shin tu che bas na/ rang gzhan gang la'ang phan pa'i nye bar mkho ba yin no/ /smras pa/ ngan 'gror 'phen byed sdig sgrib kyi/ /dri ma bag chags bcas pa kun/ /drung 'byin skra chog bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'di ko sngon med gaṅgā'o/ /zhes skra chog sdig sgrib kun 'joms zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis gzhan la phan par gyur na snyam pa'i 'dun pa kho nas dam pa'i man ngag dang mthun par sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/skra chog sdig sgrib kun 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 278--PAGE 277--PAGE 276-
